title: agentd --capabilities manifest (ACC v2, informational)
$comment: ACC v2 treats the capabilities manifest as INFORMATIONAL, not the negotiation anchor: v1.3.1 emits no contract_version and no surfaces{} block (upstream ask U3), and under-reports (no webhooks key; workflows[].start_kinds omits webhook and stream). Negotiation anchors instead on the config schema's x-agentd-contract-version, the workflow schema $id, exit_codes, and metrics_schema (see SPEC.md §3). This schema is deliberately permissive (additive upstream changes must not break readers); requireds are the minimal stable core.

version.description: the agentd semver, e.g. 1.3.1 — identify, never feature-detect from it

start_kinds.description: KNOWN GAP: webhook and stream starts report as absent/empty at 1.3.1 — do not infer 'no trigger' from an empty list

skills.description: KNOWN GAP: reports sources count only — skills.dir and inline skills are not reflected

command_ops.description: KNOWN GAP: omits workflow-declared a2a commands

daemon.description: KNOWN GAP: under-reports for stream/webhook-start-only, a2a-start-only, webhooks.listen and goal instances — never the Deployment-vs-Job oracle; the operator decides shape from the rendered spec
